articles.summary: Insteel Industries Inc. (NYSE: IIIN) today announced that its board of directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.03 per share and a special cash dividend of $1.00 per share of common stock payable on December 11, 2026, to shareholders of record as of November 27, 2026. “This special dividend reflects our confidence in Insteel’s financial position and long-term outlook,” commented H.O. Woltz III, Insteel’s President and CEO. “We believe the $1.00 per share distribution strikes an appropriate balance between providing a meaningful return to shareholders and retaining the resources to support our operating needs, fund capital investments and pursue growth opportunities.” About Insteel Insteel is the nation’s largest manufacturer of steel wire reinforcing products for concrete construction applications. articles.title: Insteel Industries Declares Regular Quarterly and Special Cash Dividends
